evals.name: missing upstream skill stops the run
evals.prompt: /grill-to-tickets Add a copy-link button to the report page. to-tickets and scrutinize are not installed anywhere.
evals.expected_output: Preflight stops before the interview, names to-tickets and scrutinize, and prints the install line for each (mattpocock/skills for to-tickets, thananon/9arm-skills for scrutinize), then waits.
expectations: Prints each missing skill's own install line

evals.name: no Tracker doc points to the upstream setup skill
evals.prompt: /grill-to-tickets Add saved searches to the dashboard. All six upstream skills are installed but the project has no docs/agents/issue-tracker.md.
evals.expected_output: The run stops and points to the upstream setup skill with its install line, without guessing where the spec and tickets live.
expectations: Points to the upstream setup skill and prints its install line
Does not invent a spec or ticket location

evals.name: full flow with a local Tracker
evals.prompt: /grill-to-tickets Add a subtitle font-size preference to the player settings panel, remembered per device. Everything is installed and the Tracker is local markdown.
evals.expected_output: Follows grill-with-docs, to-spec, one scrutinize review in a fresh subagent that reads the spec file and edits nothing, shows all findings and lets the person choose fixes, edits the spec file with the chosen fixes, passes the spec path to to-tickets, then prints the spec path, the ticket paths, and /clear then /implement-tickets <spec path>.
expectations: Runs the four upstream stages in the agreed order in the main context
Runs the review once in a fresh subagent that edits nothing
Shows every finding and lets the person choose which to fix
Applies the chosen fixes to the spec file and shows the verdict without routing on it
Passes the spec reference to to-tickets and never implements

evals.name: remote Tracker whose tool cannot edit a body
evals.prompt: /grill-to-tickets Add saved searches to the dashboard. The Tracker is a remote issue service whose tool can create issues and comments but cannot edit an issue body. The person chose two findings to fix.
evals.expected_output: The chosen corrections are added as a comment on the published spec issue, no second review starts, and the spec issue reference is passed to to-tickets.
expectations: Adds the corrections as a comment on the spec
Passes the spec issue reference to to-tickets

evals.name: no subagents available
evals.prompt: /grill-to-tickets Add a copy-link button to the report page. The harness has no subagent support.
evals.expected_output: The scrutinize review runs in the main context, the run says so, and the findings and choice of fixes proceed as usual.
expectations: Runs the review in the main context
Says that the review did not run in a fresh subagent
Still shows all findings and lets the person choose
